hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/before_shell.py"; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/before_shell.py"; else exec py -3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/before_shell.py"; fi'
hooks.commandWindows: if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 (Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts/before_shell.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python (Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts/before_shell.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { python3 (Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts/before_shell.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE }

hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/before_shell.py" --event permission; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/before_shell.py" --event permission; else exec py -3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/before_shell.py" --event permission; fi'
hooks.commandWindows: if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 (Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts/before_shell.py') --event permission; exit $LASTEXITCODE } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python (Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts/before_shell.py') --event permission; exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { python3 (Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts/before_shell.py') --event permission; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
